evidence: The paper develops an R package for stacking ensemble learning. It demonstrates the method on three datasets using multiple base learners (ranger/random forest, XGBoost, GBM, SVM, elastic net, PLS). No variable importance measures are discussed. Feature selection in the cancer analysis explicitly uses Wilcoxon rank-sum tests: "the top 2000 transcripts from 57,905 transcripts were selected based on P-values obtained with Wilcoxon rank-sum tests between pCR and other categories." The focus is prediction accuracy (Pearson correlation, kappa coefficients), not feature ranking or importance magnitude.
